properties.displayName: SOC Lab - Password Spray from One Source IP
properties.description: One source IP fails 10+ logons against 3+ different accounts within 10 minutes (wordlist brute force / password spraying, T1110.001/T1110.003). Built after the honeypot attack in INC-0002. Grouped by source IP so one attack is one incident.
properties.query:
// One source IP failing logons against several different accounts (password spraying / wordlist brute force).
// Complements repeated-windows-signin-failures.kql, which counts failures per account and so splits
// a multi-username attack into one alert per account. MITRE ATT&CK T1110.001 / T1110.003.
// Scheduled every 5 min over 10 min. Tuned on the honeypot data in evidence/honeypot-final-2347Z.md.
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(10m) and EventID == 4625
| where isnotempty(IpAddress) and IpAddress !in ("-", "127.0.0.1", "::1")
| summarize FailedAttempts = count(),
            DistinctAccounts = dcount(TargetUserName),
            Accounts = make_set(TargetUserName, 20),
            Hosts = make_set(Computer, 10),
            SubStatuses = make_set(SubStatus, 5),
            FirstFailure = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastFailure = max(TimeGenerated)
    by IpAddress
| where FailedAttempts >= 10 and DistinctAccounts >= 3
| extend Computer = tostring(Hosts[0]),
         ExistingAccountHit = SubStatuses has "0xc000006a"
| project TimeGenerated = LastFailure, IpAddress, Computer, FailedAttempts, DistinctAccounts,
          Accounts, Hosts, ExistingAccountHit, FirstFailure, LastFailure
